result.subject: Welcome to London office – Wed 25 Nov
result.body:
Dear Head of Data candidate team,

We look forward to welcoming you on Wednesday 25 November at 10:00 for an interview panel.

Our office is located at 3rd Floor, 21 Copper Row, London EC2A 4LT.

Please proceed to reception on the ground floor and present photo ID to collect building passes. The nearest stations are Liverpool Street (6 min walk) and Moorgate (8 min). Guest Wi‑Fi details will be displayed on the welcome screen in your meeting room.

You will be received by the Head of People in Meeting room 4.

Agenda:
- Welcome and office tour
- Panel interview
- Meet the team
- Close and next steps

Kind regards,
Business Operations
